dnsAutopilot.description: A one-off sync of MX/SPF/DKIM/DMARC/MTA-STS records via the Cloudflare or Selectel API using the "Autoconfigure" button in the domain DNS wizard is available in every edition. Automatic background reconciliation (the Pro part) is in development.

advancedDashboard.title: Advanced dashboard
advancedDashboard.description: Deliverability charts, queue forecast, and capacity planning on admin dashboard. In development.

backupCenter.title: Backup center
backupCenter.description: Managed backup with storage health checks and recovery rehearsal. In development; use the Community restic backups for now (docs/BACKUP.md).

branding.title: White-Label Branding

dmarcIntelligence.description: Full source IP addresses from DMARC reports, history up to 90 days, and raw XML RUA report downloads. Included with any Pro lease; there is no separate switch. Reports are uploaded manually.

multiTenantRbac.title: Multi-Tenant RBAC & Quotas
multiTenantRbac.description: Advanced multi-tenancy and role model beyond the basic domain admins and quotas (available in Community). In development.

priorityUpdates.title: Priority updates
